title: The Satavahana dynasty mainly ruled which region of ancient India?
description: Identify the principal region associated with Satavahana rule.
hint: Think of the Deccan region.
summary: The Satavahanas were a major dynasty of the Deccan.

title: Which city is generally regarded as an important early capital of the Satavahanas?
description: Identify the city associated with the early Satavahana capital.
hint: It was located in present-day Maharashtra.
summary: Pratishthana, or Paithan, was an important Satavahana capital.

title: What was Pratishthana known as in later times?
description: Identify the modern name of the ancient Satavahana center Pratishthana.
hint: It is a historic city in Maharashtra.
summary: Pratishthana is identified with modern Paithan.

title: Which ruler is considered the founder of the Satavahana dynasty?
description: Identify the traditional founder of the Satavahana dynasty.
hint: His name appears in the Puranic traditions.
summary: Simuka is generally regarded as the founder of the Satavahana dynasty.

title: Which Satavahana ruler is famous for defeating the Western Kshatrapas?
description: Identify the prominent Satavahana ruler who expanded the kingdom against the Shakas.
hint: His mother's name appears in his famous matronymic.
summary: Gautamiputra Satakarni defeated the Western Kshatrapas and expanded Satavahana power.

title: The title 'Dakshinapathapati' is associated with which Satavahana ruler?
description: Identify the ruler associated with this title in Satavahana history.
hint: He was one of the most powerful Satavahana rulers.
summary: Gautamiputra Satakarni is associated with the title Dakshinapathapati.

title: Which inscription provides important information about Gautamiputra Satakarni?
description: Identify the inscription that records the achievements of Gautamiputra Satakarni.
hint: It was issued by his mother.
summary: The Nasik inscription of Gautami Balashri is an important source for Gautamiputra Satakarni.

title: Who was Gautami Balashri?
description: Identify Gautami Balashri in the context of Satavahana history.
hint: She was the mother of a famous Satavahana ruler.
summary: Gautami Balashri was the mother of Gautamiputra Satakarni.

title: Which Satavahana ruler is traditionally associated with the Gatha Saptashati?
description: Identify the ruler credited with compiling this Prakrit anthology.
hint: His name is associated with Prakrit literature.
summary: King Hala is traditionally credited with compiling the Gatha Saptashati.

title: Gatha Saptashati was composed mainly in which language?
description: Identify the language used for this famous Satavahana-period anthology.
hint: It was a Middle Indo-Aryan language.
summary: Gatha Saptashati is a Prakrit anthology, traditionally associated with Maharashtri Prakrit.

title: Which language was widely used in Satavahana inscriptions?
description: Identify the principal language used in many Satavahana inscriptions.
hint: It was a Middle Indo-Aryan language.
summary: Prakrit was widely used in Satavahana inscriptions.

title: Which script was commonly used in Satavahana inscriptions?
description: Identify the script used for writing many Satavahana inscriptions.
hint: It developed from the ancient Brahmi script.
summary: Brahmi script was commonly used in Satavahana inscriptions.

title: Which site contains important Satavahana-period cave inscriptions?
description: Identify the major western Deccan site associated with Satavahana inscriptions.
hint: The site is near Nashik.
summary: Nasik Caves contain important inscriptions from the Satavahana period.

title: Which caves are particularly associated with Satavahana-period Buddhist architecture?
description: Identify the cave complex famous for early Buddhist architecture in the western Deccan.
hint: The caves are located in Maharashtra.
summary: The Karla Caves are an important example of Buddhist architecture from the Satavahana period.

title: What type of Buddhist structure is especially prominent at Karla?
description: Identify the major Buddhist architectural structure represented at Karla.
hint: It is a prayer hall containing a stupa.
summary: Karla is famous for its large Buddhist chaitya hall.

title: Which Buddhist site in Andhra Pradesh became an important center during the Satavahana period?
description: Identify the major Buddhist center associated with Satavahana patronage.
hint: It is famous for a large stupa.
summary: Amaravati became an important Buddhist center under Satavahana influence.

title: The Amaravati school of art is primarily associated with which religion?
description: Identify the religious tradition represented prominently in Amaravati sculpture.
hint: Think of the major religion that flourished around Amaravati.
summary: The Amaravati school is strongly associated with Buddhist art.

title: Which architectural feature is associated with the Buddhist chaitya halls of the Satavahana period?
description: Identify the important sacred architectural element generally found inside a chaitya hall.
hint: It was an important Buddhist symbol.
summary: A stupa was the central sacred element of a Buddhist chaitya hall.

title: Which dynasty was a major contemporary rival of the Satavahanas in western India?
description: Identify the dynasty that frequently competed with the Satavahanas.
hint: They were also known as the Shakas of western India.
summary: The Western Kshatrapas were major rivals of the Satavahanas.

title: Which ruler of the Western Kshatrapas was defeated by Gautamiputra Satakarni?
description: Identify the Kshatrapa ruler defeated during Gautamiputra's campaigns.
hint: His name appears in the Nasik inscription.
summary: Nahapana was defeated by Gautamiputra Satakarni.

title: Who was Rudradaman I?
description: Identify Rudradaman I in the context of Satavahana history.
hint: He belonged to a rival dynasty.
summary: Rudradaman I was a prominent ruler of the Western Kshatrapas.

title: Which inscription is famous for recording the achievements of Rudradaman I?
description: Identify the important inscription associated with Rudradaman I.
hint: It is located near Junagadh.
summary: The Junagadh inscription of Rudradaman I is a major historical source.

title: What was a distinctive feature of many Satavahana royal names?
description: Identify the naming practice seen in names such as Gautamiputra Satakarni.
hint: The name often refers to the ruler's mother.
summary: Satavahana rulers often used matronymics, such as Gautamiputra.

title: The name 'Gautamiputra' literally indicates a connection with whom?
description: Interpret the matronymic element in Gautamiputra's name.
hint: Gautami was his mother's name.
summary: Gautamiputra means son of Gautami.

title: Which Satavahana ruler is associated with the Periplus of the Erythraean Sea period?
description: Identify the ruler generally associated chronologically with the flourishing of western Indian maritime trade.
hint: Think of the early centuries CE.
summary: The Satavahana period overlapped with the flourishing Indo-Roman maritime trade described in the Periplus.

title: Which type of coins were widely issued by the Satavahanas?
description: Identify the metals commonly represented in Satavahana coinage.
hint: Lead was especially characteristic of their coinage.
summary: Satavahana coinage prominently included lead coins, along with copper and other metals.

title: Which animal appears frequently on Satavahana coins?
description: Identify an important motif found on Satavahana coinage.
hint: It is a large Indian animal.
summary: The elephant is a common motif on Satavahana coins.

title: Which symbol is also found on some Satavahana coins?
description: Identify a commonly seen religious or cultural symbol in Satavahana coinage.
hint: It is a Buddhist symbol and is also called a dharmachakra.
summary: The wheel symbol occurs on Satavahana coins.

title: Which economic activity was important in the Satavahana period?
description: Identify an important source of economic activity in the Satavahana realm.
hint: The dynasty controlled routes connecting inland and coastal regions.
summary: Trade was an important part of the Satavahana economy.

title: Which ports were connected with Satavahana-period maritime trade?
description: Identify a major western coastal port associated with trade in the Satavahana period.
hint: The Periplus mentions an important port on the western coast.
summary: Kalyan was one of the important western coastal ports associated with Satavahana-period trade.

title: Which foreign power had commercial links with the Satavahana realm?
description: Identify the major Mediterranean power involved in long-distance trade with India.
hint: Roman coins have been found in parts of the Deccan.
summary: The Roman Empire had significant commercial links with the Satavahana realm.

title: Which Roman items were imported into India during the early centuries CE?
description: Identify a commodity associated with Indo-Roman trade.
hint: Think of a luxury item used at Roman tables.
summary: Roman wine was among the commodities traded with India.

title: Which social institution played an important role in the Satavahana economy?
description: Identify the organized occupational groups mentioned in inscriptions.
hint: These groups were often involved in trade and crafts.
summary: Guilds or shrenis played an important role in economic life.

title: What were shrenis in ancient Indian economic life?
description: Identify the function of shrenis during the Satavahana period.
hint: They organized people with similar occupations.
summary: Shrenis were guilds or organized associations of artisans and merchants.

title: Which religious traditions received patronage during the Satavahana period?
description: Identify the major religious traditions that flourished under Satavahana rule.
hint: Both Brahmanical traditions and Buddhism received patronage.
summary: Satavahana rulers supported Brahmanical traditions as well as Buddhism.

title: Which Vedic ritual was performed by some Satavahana rulers?
description: Identify a major Vedic royal sacrifice mentioned in Satavahana records.
hint: It was traditionally associated with royal sovereignty.
summary: The Ashvamedha sacrifice is associated with Satavahana royal patronage.

title: Which Satavahana ruler is associated with performing Vedic sacrifices such as Ashvamedha?
description: Identify the early Satavahana ruler associated with major Vedic sacrifices.
hint: His name appears in early Satavahana records.
summary: Satakarni I is associated with the performance of Vedic sacrifices including Ashvamedha.

title: Which Satavahana ruler is known as Yajna Sri Satakarni?
description: Identify the ruler associated with the revival of Satavahana power in the later period.
hint: His name includes a reference to a Vedic sacrifice.
summary: Yajna Sri Satakarni was a later and important Satavahana ruler.

title: Which Satavahana ruler is associated with the later revival of maritime activity?
description: Identify the ruler whose coins and reign indicate continued western coastal activity.
hint: He was one of the later Satavahana rulers.
summary: Yajna Sri Satakarni is associated with the later phase of Satavahana power and maritime trade.

title: Which dynasty succeeded the Satavahanas in parts of the Deccan?
description: Identify a major dynasty that emerged in the Deccan after the decline of Satavahana power.
hint: They ruled parts of the western Deccan in the early centuries CE.
summary: The Abhiras and other regional powers emerged after the decline of the Satavahanas; the Ikshvakus also succeeded them in the eastern Deccan.

title: Which dynasty succeeded the Satavahanas in the lower Krishna-Guntur region?
description: Identify the dynasty that rose to power in the eastern Deccan after the Satavahanas.
hint: Their capital was associated with Vijayapuri.
summary: The Ikshvakus succeeded the Satavahanas in parts of the lower Krishna region.

title: Which place became an important Buddhist center under the Ikshvakus after the Satavahanas?
description: Identify the archaeological site associated with the Ikshvaku period.
hint: It is located in present-day Andhra Pradesh.
summary: Nagarjunakonda became an important Buddhist center under the Ikshvakus.

title: Which site is particularly important for understanding Satavahana-period Buddhist art?
description: Identify the famous Buddhist site associated with the Amaravati school.
hint: It is located on the Krishna River.
summary: Amaravati is an important site for studying Satavahana-period Buddhist art.

title: The Satavahana economy benefited significantly from control of which geographical routes?
description: Identify the major routes that supported Satavahana trade.
hint: These routes connected the interior with coastal ports.
summary: The Satavahanas benefited from inland and maritime trade routes across the Deccan.

title: Which river valley was particularly important in the eastern Satavahana sphere?
description: Identify the major river associated with eastern Deccan settlements and trade.
hint: It flows through present-day Telangana and Andhra Pradesh.
summary: The Krishna River valley was important in the eastern Deccan during the Satavahana period.

title: Which river valley was important to the Satavahana heartland around Pratishthana?
description: Identify the major river associated with Paithan and the western Deccan.
hint: Paithan is located on this river.
summary: The Godavari River was important to the Satavahana heartland around Pratishthana.

title: Which source gives valuable information about Satavahana political history through its dynastic accounts?
description: Identify the ancient Indian texts that preserve lists of Satavahana rulers.
hint: They are ancient religious-historical texts.
summary: The Puranas provide important dynastic information about the Satavahanas.

title: Which foreign account is useful for understanding trade in the western Indian Ocean during the Satavahana period?
description: Identify the Greco-Roman maritime trade text.
hint: Its title means a guide to the Red Sea.
summary: The Periplus of the Erythraean Sea provides information about Indian Ocean trade.

title: Which feature best describes Satavahana religious policy?
description: Identify the broader religious pattern visible in Satavahana-period evidence.
hint: Evidence exists for both Brahmanical and Buddhist patronage.
summary: Satavahana rulers and elites supported multiple religious traditions.

title: Why are the Satavahanas important in ancient Indian history?
description: Identify the major historical significance of the Satavahana dynasty.
hint: Consider their role in the Deccan, trade, religion, and culture.
summary: The Satavahanas played a major role in Deccan political history and supported trade, Buddhism, Brahmanical traditions, art, and literature.

options.title: They had no connection with trade
They existed only as a small local kingdom
They were a major Deccan power with important cultural and commercial links
